{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the premise: internal test orders have revenue = 999999.99
internal_test_count = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {internal_test_count}")

# Check if any row has revenue = 999999.99
has_internal_test = internal_test_count > 0

# Confirm status values
print(f"Unique status values: {sales['status'].unique()}")

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and non-test orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
non_test_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = non_test_orders['revenue_float'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed, non-test orders: {total_revenue}")

# Return the result
print(total_revenue)"}
